scenes.headline: How activation checkpoints move off the GPU
scenes.sub: Transformers 5.17 and Arctic Platform, side by side
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Quire! Today: how training moves its last per-layer tensor off the GPU, and why the copy can be free.

scenes.text: Checkpointing keeps only each layer's input, and that input sits idle until backward, so it can wait in pinned host memory instead.
scenes.say: Checkpointing keeps only each layer's input. That input sits idle until backward reaches it. So it can wait in host memory instead.

scenes.title: One layer's checkpoint, out and back

steps.say: In forward, a checkpointed layer saves just one tensor: its input, the residual stream.
A hook copies that tensor to pinned host memory, and the GPU copy is freed.
In backward, it is copied back, ideally one layer early, so the recompute finds it waiting.

left.title: Transformers save_on_cpu
left.say: Transformers wraps each checkpoint in save on CPU. Its copies run on the compute stream, so the GPU waits for them.

right.title: Arctic Platform
right.say: Arctic copies on two side streams and prefetches the previous layer, so the copies run under compute.

scenes.title: When is the copy free?
scenes.text: copy = b x s x h x 2 / bandwidth

parts.match: b x s x h x 2
parts.note: bytes of one layer's checkpoint in bf16
parts.say: One checkpoint is batch times sequence times hidden, two bytes each.
Divide by the host link's bandwidth. If that is shorter than the layer's compute, overlap hides it.

scenes.title: Synchronous slowdown, Qwen3-8B on PCIe 5
scenes.note: first-order arithmetic; overlapped is 0% in every row
scenes.say: Worked out for an eight billion parameter model, the synchronous cost shrinks as sequences grow, because attention compute grows faster than the copy.

steps.say: Without offload, memory climbs with every layer in forward. A hill.
With checkpoint offload to CPU, the hill is gone. Only the backward spikes remain.

scenes.text: The checkpoint is idle between forward and backward, so with overlapped copies moving it costs almost nothing.
scenes.say: The checkpoint is idle between forward and backward. Overlap the copies, and moving it costs almost nothing.

recap: Park it in pinned host RAM
scenes.say: Keep the input. Park it on the host. Overlap the copies.
